mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_slot_preference ( user_id, slot_name, option_value, preference_score, positive_count, negative_count, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{slotName}, #{optionValue}, #{delta}, #{positiveIncrement}, #{negativeIncrement}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE preference_score = LEAST(10.0, GREATEST(-10.0, preference_score + VALUES(preference_score))), positive_count = positive_count + VALUES(positive_count), negative_count = negative_count + VALUES(negative_count), updated_at = NOW()
